messages:
sarah.sales: Hey team — ACME said they're ready for the POC handback. Need a concise checklist: hosted API key invalidation, dedicated pool teardown, any VPC/on‑prem handoff steps, and a retention confirmation they can sign. Can someone own?

jake.engineering: I can take the hosted keys + dedicated pool teardown. Quick q: do we delete workspace logs immediately or do we keep the 30/90 default? Customer asked for minimal retention.

maria.security: +1 on ownership. We need a signed data-retention waiver if they want <90 days. If there's a legal hold, we snapshot and encrypt to customer KMS before any delete. Ask ACME if they've flagged data for legal hold.

ellie.custsuccess: I'll ping ACME right now for legal hold + retention window. Also confirm they want a teardown report with hashes/proofs of deletion.

ops-bot: Action created: POC-1804129999-key-revoke (assignee: jake.engineering)

jake.engineering: Plan sketch: 1) Revoke hosted API keys. 2) Drain and delete dedicated pool. 3) Run KV cache purge + confirm no prefixes left. 4) Generate deletion artifacts + timestamps. Propose teardown window: 2026-11-05 03:00 UTC (low traffic). Any objections?

tim.sre: No objections. A couple operational notes: - Don't delete pools until drains hit 0 connections. - Save autoscaler logs for 7 days for post-check. - For dedicated pools use: 
```
# drain
rwctl pool drain --id=ded-poc-acme-01
# once drained
rwctl pool delete --id=ded-poc-acme-01 --force
```
And to revoke hosted key via admin API:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/keys/revoke \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"key_id":"pk_live_acme_poc"}'
```
Make sure the admin call is executed from a bastion with MFA.

jake.engineering: I'll run the commands from bastion and paste logs into the ticket. Also will run this to purge KV cache prefixes used by the workspace:
```
redis-cli -h redis.pools.redwood --scan --pattern "acme:poc:*" | xargs -L 100 redis-cli -h redis.pools.redwood del
```
I'll capture `KEYS` counts before/after.

maria.security: For the deletion artifacts include: deletion timestamps, operator (sarah/jake), S3 object hashes for any archived snapshots, and KMS key id if we exported. If they requested <90d retention we need explicit email consent from ACME (forwarded to security@redwood.ai).

ellie.custsuccess: ACME replied: "No legal hold. We agree to 14-day retention for logs and immediate key invalidation. We do want the deletion report and timestamped confirmation." They want action within 72 hours.

sarah.sales: Thanks Ellie. Jake — can you do teardown in next 48 hours? ACME is anxious to close the POC. Also note billing: we should prorate Dedicated pool fees through the decomm timestamp and include final usage in the closing invoice.

jake.engineering: I can start the revoke + drain in ~24h. I'll set the window to 2026-10-29 02:30 UTC to keep within their 72h ask. I'll also produce a minimal artifact bundle and upload to the ticket.

ops-bot: Ticket updated: POC-1804129999 (owner: jake.engineering) — deadline 2026-10-29T02:30:00Z

tim.sre: Reminder — after pool delete, run our post-delete verification: 1) Ensure no active GPU containers in k8s cluster tagged `acme-poc`. 2) Confirm no route entries in gateway for the workspace. 3) Confirm ingress logs stop. I'll help with checks.

jake.engineering: A couple small gotchas I found from prior POCs: - If customer used Private/VPC option we need to revoke any peering or VPN credentials and confirm routing tables are cleaned. - If they had custom model uploads, ensure those are either handed off or securely deleted (ask customer which).

maria.security: Good flag. Ellie, confirm whether ACME uploaded any customer models or datasets to the workspace. If yes, record which ones and whether they want them returned or deleted.

ellie.custsuccess: ACME says they uploaded two training datasets. They want them deleted. I'll get written confirmation for deletion of those artifacts.

sarah.sales: Also need to capture final acceptance sign-off from ACME before we close. I'll send a one-click sign-off link (doc) once jake uploads evidence.

jake.engineering: Will post the logs + command output and the S3 deletion receipts. After we get their sign-off, I'll rotate any retained admin keys and close the ticket. :white_check_mark:

maria.security: Once done security will do a quick audit and then mark the workspace as cleared. Please cc security@redwood.ai on the acceptance email.

sarah.sales: Great. Summarizing owners: hosted keys & pool teardown = jake.engineering; legal/retention advisory = maria.security; customer comms = ellie.custsuccess; SRE verification = tim.sre. I'll mark the thread resolved after sign-off.

ops-bot: Workflow note: please attach all artifacts to the ticket (POC-1804129999) for audit trail.
